purpose: A pending used-yield input holds the old visited object independently of the foreach array. Caller writes COW the source array and promptly retire only its new values; parked close preserves both the old container and buffered object count.
source:
<?php
class ReviewBufferedLoopOldA24 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedLoopOldB24 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedLoopNewC24 { function __destruct() { echo "CNEW|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedLoopNewD24 { function __destruct() { echo "DNEW|"; } }
function reviewBufferedLoopCowLeaf24() { global $items; try { echo "C|"; foreach ($items as $item) { unset($items); echo "V|"; $input = yield 7 => 5; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewBufferedLoopCowLower24() { try { echo "L|"; yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-LOWER|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewBufferedLoopCowUpper24() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["lower"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewBufferedLoopCowOuter24() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$items = [new ReviewBufferedLoopOldA24(), new ReviewBufferedLoopOldB24()]; $exception = new Exception("buffered-foreach-cow24");
$child = reviewBufferedLoopCowLeaf24(); $lower = reviewBufferedLoopCowLower24(); $upper = reviewBufferedLoopCowUpper24(); $outer = reviewBufferedLoopCowOuter24();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|";
echo "S|", $lower->send($items[0]), "|";
$items[0] = new ReviewBufferedLoopNewC24(); $items[1] = new ReviewBufferedLoopNewD24(); echo "W|";
unset($items); echo "DROP|";
try { $upper->throw($exception); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $exception ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $upper->current(), "|", $upper->key(), "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($lower); echo "LOW|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|";
unset($caught, $exception); echo "E";

purpose: The iterator container embeds a shared cell while the used-yield input separately owns its old referent. A real post-close cell write replaces the retained container edge, but the old object survives in the orphan input until request store; the new referent survives through the retained cell.
source:
<?php
class ReviewBufferedLoopCellA24 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedLoopCellB24 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedLoopCellC24 { function __destruct() { echo "CNEW|"; } }
function reviewBufferedLoopCellLeaf24() { global $slot; try { echo "C|"; foreach ([&$slot, new ReviewBufferedLoopCellB24()] as $item) { unset($slot); echo "V|"; $input = yield 3 => 11; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewBufferedLoopCellLower24() { try { echo "L|"; yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-LOWER|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewBufferedLoopCellUpper24() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["lower"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewBufferedLoopCellOuter24() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$slot = new ReviewBufferedLoopCellA24(); $exception = new Exception("buffered-foreach-cell24");
$child = reviewBufferedLoopCellLeaf24(); $lower = reviewBufferedLoopCellLower24(); $upper = reviewBufferedLoopCellUpper24(); $outer = reviewBufferedLoopCellOuter24();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|";
echo "S|", $lower->send($slot), "|";
try { $upper->throw($exception); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $exception ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $upper->current(), "|", $upper->key(), "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($lower); echo "LOW|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|";
$slot = new ReviewBufferedLoopCellC24(); echo "WRITE|"; unset($slot); echo "UNSET|";
unset($caught, $exception); echo "E";
